# Advisor AI Solutions

> Operator-built AI growth systems for architecture, engineering, construction, and green building firms. Get found by AI search, fill the calendar with qualified conversations, and run the pipeline from one system.

Canonical site: https://advisoraisolutions.io
Founder: Jordan Salvador
Email: jordan@advisoraisolutions.com
Phone: +1 (403) 585-6036
Book a discovery call: https://calendly.com/advisoraisolutions/intro

This business works only with AEC firms (architecture, engineering, construction, and green building). It does not sell a general AI receptionist, and it does not publish client testimonials, client logos, or outcome statistics.

## What the firm builds

1. Visibility — AI search / GEO / AEO, Google, and LinkedIn presence.
2. Outreach — Clay and Apollo sourcing, signal-based outreach, Instantly.ai, LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
3. Authority — the Advisor AI Solutions Podcast, LinkedIn thought leadership, short-form video, case-study development.
4. Pipeline — AI SDR, n8n with Claude, GoHighLevel CRM, 21-day SMS and email nurture, A2P 10DLC, dashboards, training.

Engagement options, without published prices: a complimentary AI Readiness Assessment, a custom AI Growth Engine, and a Full Growth Partner retainer plus commission. A 15-call / 90-day guarantee appeared on an older page and is not confirmed as current.
